retainedCounterWitness.functionSource: async function vCountOwned(dir){for(var name of await vFs.readdir(dir)){if(++vWorkCount.entries>15000)throw Error('FINAL_WORK_ENTRY_STOP');const filename=dir+'/'+name;const st=await vFs.lstat(filename);if(st.isSymbolicLink())throw Error('FINAL_WORK_LINK_STOP');if(st.isDirectory())await vCountOwned(filename);else if(st.isFile()){vWorkCount.bytes+=st.size;if(vWorkCount.bytes>536870912)throw Error('FINAL_WORK_BYTES_STOP');}else throw Error('FINAL_WORK_TYPE_STOP');}}
